# BuildAndDo

An educational collaboration platform where people and AI learn by doing real work together, preserve evidence and share what they learned.

## Community and store

- [r/buildanddo on Reddit](https://www.reddit.com/r/buildanddo): the public community.
- [Playbooks and courses on Gumroad](https://citadelnexus.gumroad.com): the Citadel Nexus store.

## Public pages

- [BuildAndDo — learn by doing, together](https://buildanddo.com/): BuildAndDo is an educational collaboration platform. Learn with people and AI through real projects, verify what happened, and share what you learned.
- [BuildAndDo — Hostinger 21-Day Challenge](https://buildanddo.com/hostinger-challenge): Learn by doing. Verify what you did. Do it together. Explore the proposed objective-to-evidence journey and Hostinger product roles for BuildAndDo.
- [MetaFunction Fabric Platform | BuildAndDo](https://buildanddo.com/platform): Explore the governed execution flow, capability mesh and illustrative monitoring of the MetaFunction Fabric.
- [BuildAndDo — Practice library](https://buildanddo.com/practice): Community-audited methods for real objectives, with evidence, knowledge states and lessons from each attempt.
- [BuildAndDo — Public roadmap](https://buildanddo.com/roadmap): Follow the BuildAndDo plan, its current state and the evidence needed to call work complete.
- [Pricing & early access | BuildAndDo](https://buildanddo.com/pricing): Discuss a managed paid pilot for one workspace and one approved operation, or explore early access and team rollouts.
- [About & team | BuildAndDo](https://buildanddo.com/about): Meet the people and principles behind BuildAndDo, the educational collaboration platform from Citadel Nexus Inc.
- [Classrooms & shared lessons | BuildAndDo](https://buildanddo.com/classrooms): Learn together in workspace classrooms with host-led Field Manual lessons, attendance and saved discussion.
- [Documentation | BuildAndDo](https://buildanddo.com/docs): Get started with workspaces, signals, missions, workflows and the evidence ledger. Learn what each state means.
- [The BuildAndDo journal](https://buildanddo.com/blog): Field notes on learning by doing, bounded work and keeping a traceable record of what you built.
- [Contact | BuildAndDo](https://buildanddo.com/contact): Request a scoped paid pilot, discuss commercial licensing with Citadel Nexus Inc., or ask a product question.
